name: theme
title: nb theme
author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
description: The house theme: slate ground, hairline borders as rgba tints, 10px uppercase micro-labels, tabular figures, pill state, 8px card radius, and the single warm cream note reserved for search-match highlight. Lifted verbatim from stratechery-search. Installs as src/nb-theme.css rather than src/app.css so a Tailwind v4 consumer keeps its own @import "tailwindcss" and adds one visible import line instead of relying on the CLI to merge.
